provenance: Original generated six-node diagrams; paired resolutions are not independent designs. No real system or personal image.

cases.prompt: Transcribe only the visible diagram. Return JSON with nodes (node IDs), directed_edges (strings X->Y), undirected_edges (strings X--Y with endpoints alphabetically ordered), dashed_edges (same notation as the corresponding directed or undirected edge), group_membership (strings X=Zone using each visible node ID and its group label), dashed_meaning (exact meaning word in the legend, or none when no dashed edges), and tls_labeled (boolean: whether any connector visibly has the label TLS). All first five fields are arrays of strings, sorted alphabetically with no duplicates. Count only drawn node boxes; group borders and connector crossings are not nodes. A connector without arrowheads is undirected. Do not invent edges at a crossing. Do not infer security properties beyond the visible TLS label. Return no extra keys.
